name: WaterBench_Small
description: WATER CORE bench (docs/WaterCore.md sec. 3, Phase A): the small-scale feel rigs, ONE CHUNK PER RIG along +X (z 0..31), DebrisLab pattern. NO world block on purpose (a world block would regenerate terrain every launch and refill the carves). Terrain lives only in worlds/default.db, authored by `python tools/water_bench.py build-rigs small` from the `waterBench.rigs` list below and verified against the world by layer scans. Each rig: an 8-thick Stone slab (top solid y=16) plus fills and carves applied in that order. No hydrology bake, no water at boot. Rigs: pad (S1 pour), trough (S2/C4), channel (S7 wading + S10 stream v1 with cube rocks), pond (S8 push, S13 scoop), ledge (S9 waterfall), pipes (S14 pump/pipe), bucket (C1-C5 containers). The dam break / breach / drain / splash scenarios (S3-S6) run on WaterBench_Basin.

water._comment: OFF: no implicit sea; the harness places water explicitly.

trough B (control): 2x1x3 (6 m^3) - a 0.1 m^3/s pump cannot overflow it in 20 s
